copy.help.storyIdentity: Match by color, shape and character. Small stars earn 1,000 starlight; grown stars earn 2,000. Clearing more than three actual stars adds 1,000 for each extra star. Five small stars earn 7,000. Tapping and tracing the same stars earn the same amount.
copy.help.storyChallenge: Restore Lantern Landing with {target} starlight. Gentle showers leave room to read the forecast, collect a matching family or keep a small top star for a matching arrival to grow. Swipe neighboring stars to arrange matches, tap groups or hold and draw selected traces. Finish before an arriving star has nowhere to land. There is no minimum time to win, and no Dusk, Opal Orbs or storms.
copy.help.storyRibbon: Reconnect Ribbon Crossing with {target} starlight. Swipe neighboring stars to join a family, or hold and trace five matching stars across diagonals and one empty space. Choosing a smaller shape can leave useful stars for the next clear; clearing more than three stars earns a bonus. Steady showers bring the next choices. Finish before an arriving star has nowhere to land. There is no minimum time to win, and no Dusk, Opal Orbs or storms.
copy.help.cascadeIdentity: Match stars by color and shape. Small stars earn 1,000 starlight; grown stars earn 2,000. Clearing more than three actual stars adds 1,000 for each extra star. Five small stars earn 7,000 before any chain bonus.
copy.help.cascadeChallenge: Restore Lantern Landing with {target} starlight. Gentle showers leave room to read the forecast, collect matching families and try a swap. Matching squares of 4 and crosses of 5 pop automatically. Their falling survivors may set off another shape for a chain. Finish before an arriving star has nowhere to land. There is no minimum time to win, and no Dusk, Opal Orbs or storms.
copy.help.cascadeRibbon: Reconnect Ribbon Crossing with {target} starlight. Swap stars into matching squares of 4 or crosses of 5 to pop them automatically. Tap a family or trace a selected group so the remaining stars fall into the next shape. Consecutive clears in that reaction earn a growing chain bonus. Finish before an arriving star has nowhere to land. There is no minimum time to win, and no Dusk, Opal Orbs or storms.
copy.help.cascadeTrace: Hold a star until it glows, draw through 5 or more matching stars, then lift. Your trace chooses the first stars to clear; squares or crosses formed by falling stars also pop. Each step may touch the previous star or cross one empty space in a straight line, including diagonally. Another star blocks the gap.
copy.help.cascadeBranch: You can retrace your path to branch out. Each star counts once, even when grown. Leave the board to cancel.
copy.help.cascadeOpening: A new round rains in its opening stars together. Play begins once they settle, then the forecast shows each next shower. Continuing a saved round keeps its settled board.
copy.help.cascadeRecipe: A 2×2 square of 4 matching stars or a cross of 5 pops automatically after a swap, clear or shower. Overlapping shapes clear their shared stars once. Other touching matches wait for your tap.
copy.help.cascadeChain: Falling survivors can complete another recipe, which pops next. Each clear starts with its star value and size bonus. Within one chain, the first clear earns ×1, then ×2, ×3, ×4 and ×5 for every later clear. A new action starts again at ×1. No speed streak is required.
copy.practiceMatchDetail: Tap a connected family worth at least 3 light. One ordinary star is worth 1.
copy.practiceGrownDetail: The larger star is worth 2 light. With one ordinary neighbor, this pair is enough to clear.
copy.practiceExchangeDetail: Swipe one space without holding. Exchanges are free and never clear a match automatically.
copy.practiceEmptySpaceDetail: Move sideways into an empty space. The star then falls to the lowest open space.
copy.practiceTraceDetail: Hold a star briefly, then draw through five matching stars. Only your selected stars clear. Leave the sixth star behind.
copy.practiceDiagonalDetail: A drawn constellation can connect matching stars diagonally. Ordinary taps use side-by-side neighbors.
copy.practiceGapDetail: A trace may bridge one empty space in a straight line. It cannot jump an occupied space.
copy.practiceBranchDetail: Return through the center to reach each arm. Revisited stars count only once.
copy.practiceSquareDetail: Swap the Aqua star into an exact square, then tap one of its four stars to collect it.
copy.practiceCrossDetail: Tap the five matching stars around a center. Later chapters use held drawings to spend only a chosen shape from a larger group.
copy.practiceOpalDetail: Tap a colored star beside Opal. Opal joins that family and is worth 1 light; tapping Opal alone chooses no family. Opal appears in Open sky.
copy.practiceRelayDetail: The first clear lets stars fall into a new square. Clear that square yourself to make a relay. There is no automatic clear or score multiplier.
copy.practiceTrimDetail: Keep useful stars by tracing a smaller square inside the group. Then collect the larger follow-up.
copy.practiceDropInDetail: Clear the amber stars first. Falling survivors form a square you can collect next.
copy.practiceBankDetail: Take the upper cross first. That preserves the lower square for a second clear.
copy.practiceForkDetail: Two recipes overlap. Choose the smaller square to preserve the more valuable follow-up.
copy.practiceDoubleSetupDetail: The first cross creates two squares. Take the upper square before the lower one to keep both.
copy.practiceShowersDetail: Use Next shower, start automatic showers, then pause. Pausing stops arrivals; you can still make moves or call a shower.
copy.practiceStormDetail: The forecast shows five incoming stars. Storms occur in Open sky. Watch their columns before calling this shower.
copy.practiceRoomDetail: The left column is full and a star is coming there. Clear the bottom aqua group first so the column can receive it.
copy.practiceRestorationDetail: Put the moves together to collect 18 starlight. This practice round does not change your saved game or unlock places.
copy.practiceIntro: Practice freely. Your saved sky and world stay unchanged.
copy.practiceRetryMessage: That changed the setup. Retry to practice this sequence.
copy.practiceCoordinates: Rows run from 1 at the top to 7 at the bottom; columns run from left to right.
copy.practiceDraw: Hold, then draw: {path}. Release to collect.
copy.practiceAutomatic: Watch the forecast. Let one automatic shower arrive.
copy.practiceResume: Tap Start or Resume to begin automatic showers.
copy.worldRecovery: Some world progress could not be read. Any completed saved round has been recovered. Your current sky is unchanged.
copy.worldComing: This place is part of the journey ahead. Its level is still being made.
copy.save.rejectedMessage: Your saved sky could not be opened. No older round has been loaded. When you begin a new sky, the unreadable save will be kept as a recovery copy.
copy.save.failedMessage: Your previous save is unchanged. You can keep playing, but recent changes may be lost when you close the app. Starfall will try saving again as you play.
copy.mass.title: Stars under pressure
copy.mass.helpCollapse: After nine showers the star implodes, swallowing itself and its four directly touching neighbors for no starlight. Collect it before then, or let the collapse make space. Pausing stops aging.
copy.mass.helpValue: Purple stars still match their original family. An enlarged body with an aura marks matching growth worth two starlight; age adds no points. Dusk stays in retained rounds only.
copy.mass.help: Every star, including Opal, ages with the showers—even underneath other stars. Stage two arrives after three showers; stage three turns purple after six.
copy.mass.warning: A purple star implodes in {showers}. Collect it or move its neighbors to safety.
copy.mass.targets: Swallows itself and these currently touching stars for no starlight: {positions}.

copy.help.tap: Tap matching stars connected up, down, left or right. Small stars count as 1 and grown stars as 2. You need a total of 3 to clear the group.
copy.help.identity: A grown star and a matching small star are enough. Match by color and shape. Small stars normally earn 1 starlight; grown stars earn 2. Gray stars earn none.
copy.help.trace: Hold a star until it glows, then draw through 5 or more matching stars and lift your finger. Only the stars you trace will clear. Each star can touch the previous star or cross one empty space in a straight line, including diagonally. Another star blocks the gap.
copy.help.branch: You can retrace your path to branch out. Each star counts once, even when grown. Leave the board to cancel. A four-star square can also clear as a recipe.
copy.help.accessibleTrace: With VoiceOver, use Add to constellation on each star, then Release constellation. Use Cancel constellation to start over.
copy.help.opening: New skies begin with a few quick showers. You can clear stars as they settle. Your chosen shower pace follows the opening.
copy.help.forecast: The trail shows the stars in the next shower. The round ends when an arriving star has nowhere to land. Clearing stars does not reset the shower countdown.
copy.help.growth: When a matching star lands on a small star, that star grows. A grown star cannot grow again; the next star stacks above it.
copy.help.opal: The round white Opal Orb can join one matching color. Start a tap match or trace on a colored star to include it. The orb counts as 1, never grows, and disappears when cleared. It cannot connect different colors in one clear.
copy.help.storm: New skies alternate 9 lighter showers with 3 heavy storm showers. Heavy showers bring more stars. Faster showers leave less time between arrivals. The forecast describes the next shower, including when its pace changes.
copy.help.retained: Older saved skies and their replays keep their original shower rules. Choose New sky to use the current rules.
copy.help.dusk: Dusk turns stars directly above, below, left or right gray. Gray stars still match and grow, but earn no starlight. Each shower with a touching star feeds Dusk once. After {feeds} feeding showers, Dusk swallows those stars and disappears. This frees space without earning starlight.
copy.help.duskClear: Clear a matching group directly beside Dusk to remove it early. Surviving gray stars regain their light. Stars in the clearing group earn their reward before Dusk is removed, so any still-gray stars in that group earn zero.
copy.help.darkLegacy: In this saved sky, dark stars block nearby growth. Clear a matching group directly beside one to remove it. They do not feed or turn other stars gray.
copy.help.pause: Pause sky stops automatic showers. You can keep clearing or tap Next shower for one shower. Opening the menu or leaving the app suspends play. Missed showers do not build up.
copy.help.swap: Swipe a star left, right, up or down to swap with its neighbor immediately. Each swipe moves one space, whatever the colors. Moving into an empty space lets stars fall. Hold still first when you want to draw a constellation.
copy.help.recipe: A square uses exactly 4 matching stars; a cross uses 5. Trace the shape to clear only those stars. In Open Sky, an Opal Orb can join their color.
copy.help.relay: Clearing supporting stars can drop others into a new shape. Clear that new shape to build a relay. Shapes wait until you clear them: there is no automatic chain reaction or score multiplier.
copy.help.challenge: Restore Lantern Landing with 18 starlight. Each clear brings its light back. Finish before an arriving star has nowhere to land. Swipe neighboring stars to arrange matches, tap groups or hold and draw selected traces and shape recipes. Showers arrive at a steady pace. This place has no Dusk, Opal Orbs or storms.

copy.help.seed: Wake Seed Moon with 18 starlight. Each clear helps the sleeping seed grow roots, leaves and a glowing shelter inside the split moon. Finish before an arriving star has nowhere to land. Swipe neighboring stars to arrange matches, tap groups or hold and draw selected traces and shape recipes. Showers arrive at a steady pace. This place has no Dusk, Opal Orbs or storms.

copy.help.patternsControls: Swipe a star toward a neighbor to exchange them, or into an empty space. Matching patterns pop as soon as the stars settle. Tap a star for guidance. With VoiceOver, use its Move left, Move right, Move up or Move down action.
copy.help.patternsSwap: Swipe one space left, right, up or down. Swap with a neighboring star or move into an empty space; matching patterns pop after the stars settle.
copy.help.patternsRecipe: Arrange a 2×2 square of 4 matching stars, a cross of 5, or a full row or column of 7. Each pattern counts actual stars, including each grown star once. Patterns pop automatically after a swap or shower. Overlapping patterns spend each shared star once.
copy.help.patternsChallenge: Restore Lantern Landing with {target} starlight. Read the forecast and swipe stars into matching squares of 4, crosses of 5, or full lines of 7. Patterns pop automatically; falling survivors can make the next pattern and build a chain. Gentle showers leave room to try a setup. Finish before an arriving star has nowhere to land.
copy.help.patternsRibbon: Reconnect Ribbon Crossing with {target} starlight. Arrange matching squares of 4, crosses of 5, or full rows and columns of 7. Patterns pop automatically. Plan the falling survivors so one automatic pop sets off another. Chains earn a growing bonus. Keep room for the announced shower and finish before an arriving star has nowhere to land.
copy.help.practiceModes: Tutorial practices Open Sky’s tap and trace controls. These restoration rounds use automatic patterns and swaps.
